info.title: Skills Ecosystem API
info.description: Skills Ecosystem API v1 (TYM × MCS Joint Venture). Every route runs for the training provider resolved from the host, or from the X-Tenant header on platform hosts. The web app uses same-origin cookie sessions; the mobile app uses Bearer tokens bound to a device.
